Sentence (English): It doesn't wash.
Comments (English): [ It's really not that good. ] || ---------------- || It doesn't wash. There must be a reason it's cheap. I used an LG dishwasher built-in for four years, but it became unusable due to wear and tear, so I ended up buying this. I didn't know that the performance would be this bad, even though it's less than half the price. Whether I put in a little or empty it, it doesn't wash anything no matter what I do. The soap is slippery. The grease is slippery. It's just for storing dishes. Is a dishwasher something that you wash, put in, run the machine, and clean again? It's so stressful because it feels like I paid money for a piece of trash that just takes up space. It's on a whole other level from LG and Miele dishwashers. It feels like it's just spraying water weakly with a hose. Think about it ten more times before buying.
Comments (Original): [ 굉장히 별로에요. ] || ---------------- || 씻기질 않아요. 저렴한데는 이유가 있나봐요. 엘지 식기세척기 빌트인해서 사년 쓰다가 이시하는 바람에 설치가 불가해서 사게됐는데요…반의 반의 반값도 안하는 제품이지만 이렇게 까지 성능이 별로일줄은 몰랐어요.ㅠ 적게 넣어도 한층 비워서 해봐도 이래해도 저래해도 다 안씻기구요 , 비누도 미끄덩. 기름기도 미끄덩. 그냥 식기보관용 이에요. 세척하고 넣고 기계돌리고 다시 닦는게 식세기 인가요…. 자리만 차지하는 쓰레기를 돈주고 산것같아 넘나 스트레스입니다. 엘지, 밀레 식세기랑은 차원이 달라요. 그먕 물을 호스로 휘이휘이 힘없이 뿌리는것같아요. 고민 열번 더 하고 사시길..

The Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is a product that combines space efficiency, design, and performance. It's especially recommended for single-person households or small kitchens seeking a premium dishwashing experience. Its no-installation, no-drill design makes it easy to use, and the lack of a complex installation process is one of its biggest advantages. Its sophisticated design and luxurious color palette exude a clean and sophisticated aesthetic, adding a touch of sophistication without compromising your kitchen's interior. The simple design and stylish colors blend seamlessly into any space, eliminating the clunkiness typical of dishwashers, demonstrating a product that's truly aesthetically pleasing. Outstanding performance and practical features: The powerful tornado water stream delivers a thorough, deep clean, leaving no water spots behind. The "55°C Safe Dry" feature inhibits bacterial growth for a hygienic finish. A separate drying mode allows for drying without washing, offering significant versatility. Its high satisfaction rating is due to the fact that it eliminates water marks and stains that commonly occur on dishes after washing. It also features a dedicated detergent, ensuring excellent cleaning power and compatibility. Despite its 3-person size, the interior is spacious enough to accommodate dishes, cups, and even simple cooking utensils. The design allows for flexible dish arrangement, making it convenient to use. It also helps reduce electricity consumption by allowing you to cook one or two meals at a time. A two-year warranty also enhances product reliability. Note: Because of its mini size, it may be difficult to store larger cooking utensils like pots and pans at once. Therefore, it is best suited for those who plan to use it primarily for basic dishes. Sentence (English): I spent a month debating between Samsung and other brands before making this purchase, but I am quite disappointed.
Comments (English): I spent a month debating between Samsung and other brands before making this purchase, but I am quite disappointed. I chose Samsung because it is a budget model and the buttons are located on the top. When I saw it in person at the store, the front buttons were really bothersome. Aside from that, there are a few things I found disappointing. I will write this in an informal style. 1. You cannot submit a 1:1 inquiry about the product on the product page. Even when I inquired on Samsung.com, they told me that the site only accepts questions regarding sales and shipping, and that I should go to samsungsvc.co.kr to ask questions. A not-so-satisfactory response was posted two days later. Other brands allow you to ask questions on the product page and receive immediate responses. 2. The SmartThings widget is very inconvenient. You can create a shortcut icon on the home screen. However, you have to register the dishwasher on/off function separately in Smart Routines for the widget (the app itself isn't very user-friendly either. If you search online, you'll find several suggestion posts, but I also see comments saying that improvements aren't being made). Other brands' apps offer various widget sizes and can even function like a remote control. 3. You must cut the 15cm baseboard. Other companies allow you to select options based on the baseboard height from the start. 4. I didn't realize this because only handleless models were available at two different stores, but upon receiving the product, I found that only the handle area is made of cheap plastic. There is a possibility of discoloration (the color is already different), and the fit is slightly off (photo attached). Upon closer inspection, I noticed lifting in other places as well, so I plan to make an inquiry. 5. Unlike other companies, the review photos suffer from severe image quality degradation. It is impossible to zoom in to check details. Conversely, this means problems might not be visible to the naked eye (the lifting of the handle panel in the first photo is not clearly visible on the review screen). This is my first purchase of Samsung appliances, and I have learned a lot from this experience. I wonder if I will earn points for a review like this. #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation
Comments (Original): 삼성과 타사 브랜드 한 달 고민 후 구매했는데 많이 아쉽네요. 삼성을 고른 이유는 저가 모델에 버튼이 위에 있기 때문입니다. 매장에 가서 직접 보면 정면 버튼이 참 거슬리더라고요. 이거 말곤 좀 별로다 싶은 것들이 있어요. 음슴체로 써보겠습니다. 1. 제품 페이지에서 제품에 대한 1:1문의를 못 함. 삼성닷컴에 문의해도 이 사이트는 판매와 배송 질문만 받는다, samsungsvc.co.kr 여기로 따로 가서 질문하라고 함. 썩 만족스럽지도 않은 답변이 이틀 뒤에 달림. 타사는 제품 페이지에서 질문 가능하고 답변 바로 달림.2. 스마트씽스 위젯 매우 불편. 홈화면에 바로 가기 아이콘 생성은 가능. 위젯은 스마트루틴에 식세기 켜기 끄기 따로 등록해야 함(어플 자체도 조작 편의성은 별로입니다. 검색해보면 제안글도 여럿 있던데 개선이 잘 안 된다는 글도 보이네요). 타사 어플은 위젯 크기도 다양하고 리모콘처럼 작동할 수도 있음.3. 걸레받이 15cm는 무조건 절단함. 타사는 애초에 걸레받이 높이에 따라 옵션 선택 가능.4. 매장 두 군데를 가도 손잡이 없는 모델만 있어서 몰랐는데 받아보니 손잡이쪽 재질만 저렴한 플라스틱임. 변색 가능성 있고(이미 색이 다름), 살짝 아귀가 안 맞음(사진 첨부). 자세히 보니 다른 곳도 들뜸이 있어서 문의 예정.5. 타사와 달리 후기 사진은 화질 저하 심함. 확대해서 자세히 확인 불가. 거꾸로 말해서 문제점이 눈에 안 보일 수도 있음(손잡이 패널 들뜸 첫 사진이 후기 화면에선 잘 안 보임)삼성 가전은 첫 구매인데요, 이번에 많은 것을 느끼게 됐습니다. 이런 후기도 포인트 적립해 줄지 궁금하네요. #삼성전자이벤트참여

Sentence (English): Bought this to replace a previous Kitchen Aid dishwasher.
Comments (English): Bought this to replace a previous Kitchen Aid dishwasher. I only considered this line of products to match the rest of my suite of appliances that have the same finish and handles, which it does very well. Compared to my previous dishwasher, which was the model above this one with the digital display and Pro Dry feature, this one feels to be made slightly cheaper in build quality. The top rack design is also much different, not really allowing for larger flat items like cutting boards. Overall, very quiet when running, looks nice with the rest of their appliances, but the racks and trays all feel cheaply made. Will be curious to see how the cheaper plastic holds up to use and heat from washing.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher because my old one broke down.

It matches the kitchen color relatively well and is neat. The person who remodeled the kitchen and the person who installed it visited twice, and the installation time was short because they came to install it right after the remodel. It works well :) However, the function that operates the upper and lower parts only works on the upper part. I want to turn only the lower part because of the cutlery holder. If you put the cutlery holder on the upper part and fix it with a bowl, it is not completely impossible. I think it will be more useful with the AI function. Sentence (English): I was really satisfied from installation to use!
Comments (English): I was really satisfied from installation to use! I installed it alone, but it was easy because the instructions were well written, and it was the perfect size to put it next to the sink, so it was good for space utilization. I was worried that it would be small because it is for 6 people, but it can hold enough dishes and cooking utensils for a day for a 1-2 person household. The internal shelves are well divided, so it was easy to organize dishes, cups, chopsticks, etc. My favorite feature is the automatic door opening drying function! After washing, the door opens automatically to let the moisture and heat escape, and the dishes were much fresher. The noise was quieter than I thought, so I didn't have to worry about running it in the evening, and I was satisfied with the cleaning power because it cleaned oily pots well. I would especially recommend the high-temperature sterilization mode to those who are sensitive to hygiene management. The detergent inlet is intuitive, and the operation buttons are simple, so it was easy to operate the machine. The design is also clean, so it doesn't spoil the kitchen atmosphere. I recommend it to 1-2 person households, dual-income couples, and those living alone as an item that can save time and maintain hygiene at the same time.
Comments (Original): 설치부터 사용까지 정말 만족스러웠어요! ✨ 혼자 설치했는데 설명서가 잘 되어 있어서 어렵지 않았고, 싱크대 옆 공간에 두기 딱 좋은 사이즈라 공간 활용도도 좋았어요.  6인용이라 용량이 적을까 걱정했는데 1~2인 가구 기준 하루 치 식기, 조리도구까지 넉넉히 들어가요 ️ 내부 선반도 잘 나뉘어 있어서 접시, 컵, 젓가락 등 정리하기 편했고요.  가장 마음에 드는 기능은 자동문열림 건조 기능이에요! ️ 세척이 끝나면 문이 자동으로 열려서 습기와 열기가 빠져나가고 식기 마름 상태가 훨씬 산뜻했어요.  소음도 생각보다 조용해서 저녁에 돌려도 부담 없었고, 기름기 있는 냄비도 잘 닦여서 세척력도 만족스러웠어요. 특히 고온살균 모드는 위생 관리에 민감한 분들에게 추천하고 싶어요 ️  세제 투입구도 직관적으로 되어 있고, 조작 버튼이 단순해서 기계 조작이 어렵지 않았어요. 디자인도 깔끔해서 주방 분위기를 해치지 않았어요 1~2인 가구, 맞벌이 부부, 자취하시는 분들께 시간 절약과 위생 관리를 동시에 잡을 수 있는 아이템으로 추천드려요

Sentence (English): I've been dreaming of owning a BOSCH dishwasher for over two years!
Comments (English): [ Dream Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've been dreaming of owning a BOSCH dishwasher for over two years! The obsession started when I visited my sister and brother-in-law, who live in a household of seven with three small kids. They have two BOSCH dishwashers and alternate between them. I was amazed—they put almost everything in there, including baby food pouches (without even rinsing them! ), and everything came out spotless. It blew my mind. For eight years, I'd been living with a Whirlpool dishwasher that basically just sanitized dishes. If you didn't fully pre-wash, even a speck of food would come out baked and sealed onto the plate. When I got home, I told my husband. He didn't believe me—said there was no way a dishwasher could be that good. That Christmas, we visited again, and I made him find the dirtiest pots and dishes he could, load them up, and run a cycle. When it finished, he looked at me and said, “That's magic.” I agreed. Still, we couldn't justify replacing our dishwasher at the time—it “worked just fine.” It's taken two years for it to finally give out enough that we had to replace it. Honestly, this was the most exciting appliance purchase I've ever made. Last night, we ran our first load. My husband picked up a mug with a day-old coffee stain and asked, “Is this really going to come clean? ” I told him I wasn't sure—it probably needed to be bleached. But I was wrong. That mug came out crystal clean. I was ashamed to doubt this magical machine. Here are a few features I love so far: Three trays – The top tray is perfect for silverware, lids, and small utensils (no more things falling through! ). Adjustable middle rack – I can raise it to fit large pots or lower it for my stemmed glasses. Extremely quiet – You can barely hear it. The loudest sound is the water draining through the hose. Indicator light – It has a subtle light that lets you know it's on. Shine & Rinse compartment – I think this is what keeps everything looking polished and spotless. If you're in the market for a new dishwasher, I cannot recommend this one enough. It cost only a few hundred dollars more than our last one, but I seriously wish I had made the upgrade 10 years ago. It would've saved me a decade of pre-washing dishes before putting them in the dishwasher. I mean… is it even a dishwasher if it doesn't actually wash the dishes?

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Sentence (English): It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. I was satisfied because it was possible. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.
