Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Sentence (English): Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Sentence (English): Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

Sentence (English): Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person, Oatmeal Beige, MNDW-110OB, Customer Installation Design When I first saw this product, the first thing that caught my eye was its emotional design in oatmeal beige. It's not the typical white or steel feel, but a soft, warm color that makes the kitchen feel even more luxurious and cozy. The size is just right. At 52cm high, 45.5cm wide, and 42cm deep, it doesn't take up as much space as I thought and is easy to place on the kitchen counter. The front has a transparent door, so you can see the washing process. It feels like a small washing machine running, so I was amazed and just stared at it. Now that I can see inside, I feel confident that it's working properly. Installation Review: This product is self-installable, so it's a big advantage that it can be used right away without complicated installation. It can also be used with a water tank without a direct water connection, so I just plug it in, pour water directly into the tank, and use it right away. I really liked that there was no stress because there was no complicated installation, and I think it won't be a burden when I move. However, my house already has holes drilled because of the water purifier, so it's even better. It would be nice if it even had automatic water supply. If you search for "direct water connection" in the Minix Naver Store notice, you can find all the necessary parts and installation instructions. You can purchase the parts separately and install them. You can organize the lines by drilling holes, or if you don't want to drill holes, the website also has instructions on how to connect them with a faucet head. Since the water purifier line was already installed in my house, I separately purchased female screws and T-fittings and connected them to the water purifier and dishwasher. It's so convenient that it even has automatic water supply. ^^ The operation buttons are simple and intuitive. After selecting the mode, you just press the button, so anyone can use it easily after reading the manual a few times. And with the upgrade to PRO, a 55-degree safe drying function has been added, and the free A/S has been extended for 2 years, so you can use it with confidence. Cleaning performance The most important thing is cleaning power. I used to wash and rewash because I was worried about residual detergent, but thanks to the water pressure and rotating nozzle that were much stronger than I thought, even greasy dishes and pots were cleaned thoroughly. It was squeakier than washing dishes by hand, and it saved a lot of water and time, so there was no reason not to use a dishwasher. The cleaning cycle There are various settings, such as economy, standard, strong, quick, internal cleaning, and drying, so you can choose according to the situation. It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. Noise & Energy Efficiency It is quieter during operation than a regular washing machine. Of course, it is not completely silent, but it is not annoying and can be run at night without any problems. The power consumption is around 850W, so the electricity bill was not that big and the energy consumption was not that big, and running it in economy mode saves even more. I was satisfied because it was possible. The inside of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, so it can be used hygienically for a long time, and the filter that filters food waste can be removed and washed, so it was not difficult to maintain. The water tank and drain tank can be easily removed, so you can keep it clean by cleaning it periodically. Overall review I would like to highly recommend the Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO to people who live alone, dual-income couples, homes with small kitchens, and people who want to escape the stress of washing dishes. I am very satisfied with this product because it has an emotional design, powerful cleaning power, easy installation, and usability! I hope this review was helpful. Thank you.

It also has a high-temperature sterilization function, so you don't have to worry about hygiene. It also has an automatic drying function, so it finishes cleanly without moisture. However, please note that some water droplets may remain in the plastic container. User review Although it is said to be for 3 people, in reality, it is just the right capacity for a 1-2 person household to collect the dishes after eating three meals a day and run them all at once. It can easily fit cups, plates, rice bowls, chopsticks, and spoons. Of course, it is difficult to fit a large frying pan or wok, but it is enough for frequently used dishes. There is an automatic door opening function, so you can run it and go out, and the hot air high-temperature drying means there are no water stains on the dishes, which is nice. Above all, the best thing is that I no longer have to spend time washing dishes every time. After eating, I simply wash them in water, put them in, and press a button, which really improves my quality of life. I was satisfied because it was possible. I live with a family of two, almost a single person, so I don't need a full-size dishwasher. Space is tight, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher, and this one was perfect. First off, the design is incredibly clean and uncluttered. It won't distract from the kitchen decor, and the white color scheme creates a clean impression. Installation was easy. You can use the included hose to draw water directly from the sink, or you can connect it to a separate water supply. For now, I'm just pouring water directly into the tank. It's less cumbersome than I thought, and the pouring process is intuitive and easy to use. While the capacity is rated for three people, it easily handles the dishes after two meals. The plates, bowls, chopsticks, spoons, and cups all fit neatly into the dedicated holders, and the clean interior makes it easy to get used to, even for first-time users. The cleaning power exceeded my expectations. It cleans even greasy frying pans and concave dishes cleanly, leaving no residue. It even dries automatically thanks to an internal heater. While plastic items tend to dry a bit slower, ceramic dishes and cups are almost completely dry, making them easy to remove. It's also quite quiet. First off, the design is incredibly clean and uncluttered. It won't distract from the kitchen decor, and the white color scheme creates a clean impression. Installation was easy. You can use the included hose to draw water directly from the sink, or you can connect it to a separate water supply. For now, I'm just pouring water directly into the tank. It's less cumbersome than I thought, and the pouring process is intuitive and easy to use. While the capacity is rated for three people, it easily handles the dishes after two meals. The plates, bowls, chopsticks, spoons, and cups all fit neatly into the dedicated holders, and the clean interior makes it easy to get used to, even for first-time users. The cleaning power exceeded my expectations. It cleans even greasy frying pans and concave dishes cleanly, leaving no residue. It even dries automatically thanks to an internal heater. While plastic items tend to dry a bit slower, ceramic dishes and cups are almost completely dry, making them easy to remove. It's also quite quiet. While there's some noise, it's not too bothersome even when running at night. The standard wash time is just over an hour, which is also quite pleasant. Additionally, the "Safe Storage" function ventilates the interior after the wash, allowing you to store it the next day without worrying about odor or moisture. This was also very useful.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  일단 저는 1인 가구에 가까운 2인 가족이 생활하고 있어서 대형 식기세척기까진 필요 없고,  공간도 협소하다 보니 소형 제품을 찾다보니 이 제품이 딱이더라구요 디자인부터 말씀드리자면,  정말 깔끔하고 군더더기 없이 잘 빠졌어요.  주방 어느 공간에 둬도 인테리어에 크게 방해되지 않고, 특히 화이트 톤이라 깨끗한 인상을 줍니다.  설치는 자가 설치가 가능했어요.  기본으로 제공되는 호스를 통해 싱크대에서  물을 직접 받아 쓸 수도 있고,  급수 연결을 따로 할 수도 있는데  저는 아직은 그냥 물통에 직접 물을 붓는 방식으로 사용 중입니다. 생각보다 귀찮지 않았고, 물 붓는 부분도 직관적으로 잘 되어 있어서 어렵지 않았어요.  용량은 3인용이라고 되어 있지만,  2끼 정도 먹고 난 후 설거지 분량은 무난하게 커버됩니다. 접시, 국그릇, 젓가락, 숟가락, 컵류를  전용 거치대에 잘 맞춰 넣으면 되고,  내부 구성이 깔끔해서 처음 써보는 분들도  금방 익숙해질 수 있어요. 세척력은 기대 이상이었습니다.  기름기 있는 프라이팬, 오목한 그릇류도 깨끗하게 닦이고, 세제가 잔류되는 느낌 없이 깔끔하게 마무리됩니다. 내부에 히터가 있어서 자동으로 건조까지 되는데,  플라스틱류는 다소 덜 마르는 감이 있긴 해도 도자기 그릇이나 컵은 거의 완전 건조돼서 꺼내기 좋았습니다.  소음도 꽤 정숙한 편이에요. 작동음이 있긴 하지만 밤에 돌려도 크게 신경 쓰이지 않을 정도고,  작동 시간도 표준 세척 기준으로 1시간 남짓이라 괜찮았습니다.  추가로 ‘안심보관’ 기능이 있어서  세척 완료 후에도 내부를 환기해줘서 냄새나 습기 걱정 없이 다음 날까지 보관 가능한 점도 꽤 유용했어요 ☆

I live with a family of two, almost a single person, so I don't need a full-size dishwasher. Space is tight, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher, and this one was perfect. First off, the design is incredibly clean and uncluttered. It won't distract from the kitchen decor, and the white color scheme creates a clean impression. Installation was easy. You can use the included hose to draw water directly from the sink, or you can connect it to a separate water supply. For now, I'm just pouring water directly into the tank. It's less cumbersome than I thought, and the pouring process is intuitive and easy to use. While the capacity is rated for three people, it easily handles the dishes after two meals. The plates, bowls, chopsticks, spoons, and cups all fit neatly into the dedicated holders, and the clean interior makes it easy to get used to, even for first-time users. The cleaning power exceeded my expectations. It cleans even greasy frying pans and concave dishes cleanly, leaving no residue. It even dries automatically thanks to an internal heater. While plastic items tend to dry a bit slower, ceramic dishes and cups are almost completely dry, making them easy to remove. It's also quite quiet. While there's some noise, it's not too bothersome even when running at night. The standard wash time is just over an hour, which is also quite pleasant. Additionally, the "Safe Storage" function ventilates the interior after the wash, allowing you to store it the next day without worrying about odor or moisture. This was also very useful.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  일단 저는 1인 가구에 가까운 2인 가족이 생활하고 있어서 대형 식기세척기까진 필요 없고,  공간도 협소하다 보니 소형 제품을 찾다보니 이 제품이 딱이더라구요 디자인부터 말씀드리자면,  정말 깔끔하고 군더더기 없이 잘 빠졌어요.  주방 어느 공간에 둬도 인테리어에 크게 방해되지 않고, 특히 화이트 톤이라 깨끗한 인상을 줍니다.  설치는 자가 설치가 가능했어요.  기본으로 제공되는 호스를 통해 싱크대에서  물을 직접 받아 쓸 수도 있고,  급수 연결을 따로 할 수도 있는데  저는 아직은 그냥 물통에 직접 물을 붓는 방식으로 사용 중입니다. 생각보다 귀찮지 않았고, 물 붓는 부분도 직관적으로 잘 되어 있어서 어렵지 않았어요.  용량은 3인용이라고 되어 있지만,  2끼 정도 먹고 난 후 설거지 분량은 무난하게 커버됩니다. 접시, 국그릇, 젓가락, 숟가락, 컵류를  전용 거치대에 잘 맞춰 넣으면 되고,  내부 구성이 깔끔해서 처음 써보는 분들도  금방 익숙해질 수 있어요. 세척력은 기대 이상이었습니다.  기름기 있는 프라이팬, 오목한 그릇류도 깨끗하게 닦이고, 세제가 잔류되는 느낌 없이 깔끔하게 마무리됩니다. 내부에 히터가 있어서 자동으로 건조까지 되는데,  플라스틱류는 다소 덜 마르는 감이 있긴 해도 도자기 그릇이나 컵은 거의 완전 건조돼서 꺼내기 좋았습니다.  소음도 꽤 정숙한 편이에요. 작동음이 있긴 하지만 밤에 돌려도 크게 신경 쓰이지 않을 정도고,  작동 시간도 표준 세척 기준으로 1시간 남짓이라 괜찮았습니다.  추가로 ‘안심보관’ 기능이 있어서  세척 완료 후에도 내부를 환기해줘서 냄새나 습기 걱정 없이 다음 날까지 보관 가능한 점도 꽤 유용했어요 ☆

Sentence (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ A practical and reasonable dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This is a review I wrote after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. It arrived yesterday, so I installed it right away and used it for the first time. Honestly, I've only used large, household dishwashers before, and this was my first time using a compact one, so I didn't have high expectations. However, I was pleasantly surprised when I actually used it. The first thing I noticed upon opening the box was that it wasn't as small as I'd expected. I thought it would be compact because it's called "mini," but it's actually quite practical for a family of three. I placed it in a corner of the kitchen, and the clean design didn't take up much space, and I liked how it didn't detract from the interior design. The most convenient feature of this product is that it uses a water tank, so I don't have to worry about a direct water connection. I was able to install it myself without having to call a technician, and the user manual was clear and concise, so there was very little confusion. All I had to do was fill the tank with water and organize the drain hose, and I was ready to go! I was even secretly excited when I turned it on and started my first wash. What I was most curious about was the washing power. After dinner last night, I neatly placed the used rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, spoons, and cups in the dishwasher and ran the standard cycle. The machine's operation isn't loud, so I can use it without any worries, even on quiet nights. The first thing I noticed when I opened the door after the wash was the shine of the dishes. I was especially surprised to see that even greasy soup bowls and plates with frying pan marks were squeaky clean. Things that used to be slippery or difficult to rinse when washed by hand were completely cleaned with this machine. And since it even has a hot air dryer, I don't have to worry about moisture. My family has been very enthusiastic about this machine. Usually, we're all a bit apprehensive about who's doing the dishes, but yesterday, after dinner, we just put the dishes in and pressed a button, and everyone was praising how convenient it was. I've only used it once, but I'm already asking myself, "Why did I buy this sooner?" I think running it once or twice a day should be enough for my household's dishes, and I can just schedule the cooking utensils accordingly. It's easy to use, fits well in a small kitchen, and most importantly, it came out cleaner than I expected from the first wash. My first impression was so good that I plan to use it every day. It's already a relief to know I won't have to worry about the dishes piling up after every meal. This is the first time in a long time that I've felt good about buying a product. This is a review I wrote as part of the Coupang Experience Group! But I really like it.
Comments (Original): [ 실용적이고 합리적인 식세기! ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  어제 도착해서 바로 설치하고 첫 사용을 해봤어요. 사실 그동안 식기세척기는 큰 가정용 제품만 써봤고, 이런 소형 제품은 처음이라 큰 기대는 하지 않았어요. 그런데 막상 써보니 기대 이상으로 만족스러워서 기분이 좋았어요.  박스를 열자마자 느낀 건 생각보다 크기가 작지 않다는 거예요. ‘미니’라고 해서 정말 아담할 줄 알았는데, 3인 가족이 사용하기엔 꽤 실용적인 사이즈였어요. 주방 한쪽에 자리를 잡아봤는데, 디자인도 깔끔해서 공간을 많이 차지하는 느낌이 없었고, 인테리어를 해치지도 않아서 마음에 들었어요.  이 제품은 급수통 방식이라 직수 연결 걱정 없이 사용 가능하다는 게 가장 편했어요. 따로 설치기사 부르지 않아도 혼자서 충분히 설치 가능했고, 사용 설명서도 간단명료해서 헷갈리는 부분이 거의 없었어요. 급수통에 물을 가득 채우고 배수 호스만 잘 정리하면 준비 완료! 전원을 켜고 첫 세척을 시작했을 때 은근히 설렘까지 느껴졌답니다.  가장 궁금했던 건 세척력인데요, 어제 저녁식사 후 사용한 밥그릇, 국그릇, 접시, 수저, 컵 등을 깔끔히 정리해서 넣고 표준 코스로 돌려봤어요. 작동음이 크지 않아서 조용한 밤에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있겠더라고요.  세척이 끝난 뒤 문을 열어봤을 때 제일 먼저 눈에 들어온 건 그릇의 윤기였어요. 특히 기름기가 많은 국그릇이나 프라이팬 자국이 남은 접시까지도 뽀득하게 닦여 있어서 놀랐어요. 손으로 닦을 땐 미끌거리거나 헹굼이 애매했던 것들이, 이건 정말 깨끗하게 마무리됐어요. 열풍 건조 기능까지 있어서 물기 걱정도 없고요.  가족들 반응도 좋아요. 평소 설거지를 누가 할지 눈치 보던 분위기에서, 어제는 식사 후 식기 모아 넣고 버튼만 누르니 다들 편하다고 칭찬했어요. 아직 한 번밖에 안 써봤지만, 벌써부터 “이거 왜 이제 샀지?” 하는 얘기를 계속 하고 있어요.  하루 한두 번 돌리면 저희 집 식기는 충분히 처리 가능할 것 같고, 조리도구는 따로 타이밍 맞춰 넣으면 될 것 같아요. 사용 방법도 어렵지 않고, 주방 공간이 작아도 잘 어울리는 점, 그리고 무엇보다 첫 세척부터 기대 이상으로 깨끗하게 나온 게 만족스러웠어요.  첫인상이 너무 좋아서 앞으로도 매일 사용할 생각이에요. 매 끼니마다 쌓이는 설거지 걱정 덜 수 있을 것 같아서 벌써부터 마음이 편해졌답니다. 정말 오랜만에 ‘사길 잘했다’ 싶은 제품이에요.  쿠팡체험단으로 작성한 리뷰입니다! 근데 정말 좋아요 ㅎㅎㅎ

Honestly, I've only used large, household dishwashers before, and this was my first time using a compact one, so I didn't have high expectations. However, I was pleasantly surprised when I actually used it. The first thing I noticed upon opening the box was that it wasn't as small as I'd expected. I thought it would be compact because it's called "mini," but it's actually quite practical for a family of three. I placed it in a corner of the kitchen, and the clean design didn't take up much space, and I liked how it didn't detract from the interior design. The most convenient feature of this product is that it uses a water tank, so I don't have to worry about a direct water connection. I was able to install it myself without having to call a technician, and the user manual was clear and concise, so there was very little confusion. All I had to do was fill the tank with water and organize the drain hose, and I was ready to go! I was even secretly excited when I turned it on and started my first wash. What I was most curious about was the washing power. After dinner last night, I neatly placed the used rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, spoons, and cups in the dishwasher and ran the standard cycle. The machine's operation isn't loud, so I can use it without any worries, even on quiet nights. The first thing I noticed when I opened the door after the wash was the shine of the dishes. I was especially surprised to see that even greasy soup bowls and plates with frying pan marks were squeaky clean. Things that used to be slippery or difficult to rinse when washed by hand were completely cleaned with this machine. And since it even has a hot air dryer, I don't have to worry about moisture. My family has been very enthusiastic about this machine. Usually, we're all a bit apprehensive about who's doing the dishes, but yesterday, after dinner, we just put the dishes in and pressed a button, and everyone was praising how convenient it was. Comments (English): [ A practical and reasonable dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || This is a review I wrote after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I have two parents. They both work, so they don't have much time for housework. Housework isn't easy, you know. I took the plunge and sent it to my parents, and they loved it. 1. Comments (Original): [ 미닉스 식세기는 집안일 효율 높여주는 가심비제품 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  부모님 두분 계세요. 두 분은 일을 하셔서 집안일 할 시간이 많지 않으십니다. 집안일이라는게 쉽지 않잖아요.  큰맘 먹고 부모님한테 보내드렸는데 좋아하십니다. 1. 디자인 제품 색상이 모던해서 좋아요.  저는 차콜그레이로 선택했지만 다른 색상도 보니까 되게 모던하고  예쁘더라고요. 그래서 고민했는데 흰색은 주방에 있어서 때가 탈 수 있을것 같아서 때 타도 티 안나는 차콜 그레이로 선택했습니다. 물탱크가 없는 제품의 경우 수도와 설치해야해서 복잡한데 해당 제품은 물탱크형태로 되어 있어서 따로 설치 안해도 되어서 저 같은 기계치도 어렵지 않게 설치할 수 있었습니다.  2. 사용방법  무타공, 무설치로 큰 제약도 없고 공간만 된다면 쉽게 혼자서도 설치할 수 있습니다.  사용방법도 어렵지 않아서 처음 사용방법만 알려주면 곧잘 하실 수 있으십니다. 2단 트레이로 구성되어 있어 생각보다 많은 그릇을 수납할 수 있어요. 요령생기면 차곡차곡 효율적으로 그릇을  배치할 수 있을것 같아요.  3. 소음 / 사용 시간  소음이 있을수는 있으나 생활소음 수준이고, 틀어놓고 다른거 하고 있으면 크게 신경쓰이지 않는 수준입니다.  한번 기기 돌리는데 한시간정도 걸리는데 밥하고나서 간단하게 물로 헹궈주고 차곡차곡 담아서  기기 돌리고, 그 사이에 집안일을 하거나 외출하고 오면 딱 좋을것 같아요.  4. 설거지VS식기세척기 1인 가구 중에 그릇 한두개 사용하시는 분들은 그냥 설거지 하는게 더 낫고, 1인 가구중에 저처럼 요리많이 해서 그릇  이것저것 많이 쓰는 사람들이나 그릇 많이 사용하시는 분들은 식기세척기가 좋습니다. 5. 결론 식기세척기는 집안일 효율을 높여주는 기기로 그 시간에 다른일을 할 수 있는 메리트가 큰 기기 입니다. 그냥 설거지 하는게 나은지 식기세척기 곰곰히 생각해보고 비교해보고 해서 구매에 도움이 되셨으면 좋겠습니다! 저는 시간효율러로 강추합니다

I used it once, but it was so dry that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Recommended vs. not recommended consumers. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. It's a shame, but it's LG, so I thought the Media wouldn't have one since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I read a review and it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, so I installed it, and it does have a reservation function. Sentence (English): The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery.
Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. Sentence (English): The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery.
Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.

Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-seater media dishwasher instead of a 6-seater. ] || ---------------- || The reason I bought the 12-seater Media was because I live alone and mostly order delivery. I don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. I don't wash a lot of dishes, but I hate doing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days, then do them all at once on the weekends. It's unsanitary, and washing them on weekends makes me feel exhausted and like I haven't rested even when I'm resting. So, I decided to buy a 6-seater that I could use every day. However, the prices of 6-seater models have gone up since I looked a few months ago, with Cuckoo models ranging from 400,000 won to Samsung models ranging from 600,000 won. Furthermore, my sink is small, so I need to buy a dishwasher cabinet (average price: 200,000 won). All in all, I expected to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Until then, I'd never considered the 6-seater Media, even if it was cheaper. I wanted a familiar brand. For that price, I'd rather buy an LG 12-seater for around 700,000 won, which I thought would offer better cleaning power and allow me to handle larger pots. I looked into it, but it was a built-in model, lacking a drying function or a timer. My house doesn't allow built-in models, so I can only use a freestanding model. I started looking into freestanding models again, but they're 10-20% more expensive than built-in models and don't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash a lot of dishes, and the price kept going up beyond my initial budget, so I decided this wasn't for me. Then I found a Media 12-seater on sale for 300,000 won! Because it's freestanding, I don't need to buy unnecessary storage, and I can just install the dishwasher without spending any more! I searched for days and days until I finally found the Media 12-seater, and it looked amazing. It's cheaper than the 6-seater, but it has all the features I'd expect from a LG 12-seater in the 700,000 won range. 1. Drying function. 2. Reservation function. 3. 1/2 cycle (a course that can replace a partial wash). The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so it lacks a drying function or reservation function. But it's LG, after all. I assumed the Media 12-seater wouldn't have one, considering it's in the 300,000 won range, but it does have a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function, but it does. Also, since I live alone, I was worried about running a 12-person dishwasher every day, so I considered a similarly priced 12-person Cuckoo dishwasher with a partial wash function, but I ended up choosing the built-in model. The media doesn't have a partial wash function, but it does have a "1/2" cycle for smaller loads! I use 3-4 dishes a day, and I'm satisfied because I can run it every day without any hassle. There's also a low-temperature glass cup cycle, so it seems like it would be good for plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons: 1. It's louder than expected. It's about as loud as a washing machine. People say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's about the same volume as the TV and dishwasher, so it's not so quiet that it's drowned out by the TV. However, the reservation function means I can just run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble. ----------> (After using it several times, I found that the water stream hitting the walls and ceiling when I loaded less dishes was louder, but it was quieter on days with a lot of dishes.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are only wings at the bottom and in the middle. However, the cleaning power is good. 3. I mentioned it as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but when the drying function is running, there is a gas station smell. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once, but it was so strong that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Consumers who recommend it vs. those who do not recommend it. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it. (If it were built-in, I would spend 30 more and buy the Cuckoo Steam Shot.) If you are looking for a dishwasher for 6 people, I definitely recommend the Media, which can accommodate 12 people for the same price. If you are sensitive to asphalt issues, I do not recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy because I think it is doing the dishes for me. Just finish the 30-minute back-breaking dishwashing with 5 minutes of pre-washing and rest. + The installer was very friendly.
